title: A Heuristic Perspective on Debiasing Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on proposing a general framework for debiasing language models across various demographic attributes (primarily gender and race). While it evaluates social bias in categories like religion using existing datasets (e.g., CrowS-Pairs), it does not have a primary component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, morals, or ethics as conceptual frameworks.
